set.why: Many form when giant stars collapse, and they help scientists test our deepest ideas about gravity.

why: Not all black holes form from collapsing stars (supermassive ones' origin is unsettled); 'They form when' overstated.

set.def: medicine that stops a patient from feeling pain during surgery, by numbing part of the body or putting them fully to sleep

why: Old def's 'one small area or fully asleep' excluded regional anesthesia (spinal/epidural numbs a large area).

cloze.s: Unlike type 1, which often starts in childhood, ___ most often develops in adults and is linked to lifestyle.

why: Type 1 does not 'usually' start in childhood; a large share of cases begin in adulthood. 'often' is accurate.

set.note: Found mainly in plant foods; meat, eggs and dairy contain none.

why: 'Found only in plant foods' is false: mushrooms (fungi) also supply dietary fiber.

ex: The nurse pressed two fingers on the artery in Malik's wrist to count his pulse.
Fatty buildup inside an artery can slowly narrow it and reduce the flow of blood through it.

why: Narrowing of a generic artery does not reduce blood flow 'to the heart'; only coronary arteries supply the heart.

ex: Tomás owns a house worth $300,000 but owes $200,000 on it, so it adds $100,000 to his net worth.
By saving part of every paycheck, Aisha raised her net worth even though her salary stayed the same.

why: Paying off a loan with existing money leaves net worth unchanged; the old example taught a false financial idea.

ex: Every year that the government spends more than it collects, the national debt grows.
Liam's economics teacher explained that selling government bonds is how the country borrows the money that makes up the national debt.

why: Ex 1 was ungrammatical ('Each year the government spends..., the debt grows').

set.def: a way of thinking that centers on human worth, reason and achievement, rather than on religious teaching alone

why: Old def ('rather than religious authority') is false for Renaissance humanism, which the item's why/cloze teach and the note says was mostly Christian.
